purpose: Qualitative real-world visual cues; not an exact reference-match score or material calibration.
copyright_handling: Original images cached only for local pixel inspection and ignored by Git. Publish links and original review observations only; no redistribution license asserted.

usable_cues: Continuous clear stream entering a visible liquid surface.
Background markings/colors remain visible but distorted through cup and liquid.
Localized highlights distinguish boundaries without filling the entire liquid with uniform white.
Small connected impact disturbance on the free surface.
not_a_match_target_for: Thick glass wall dimensions: reference is a different, thinner graduated cup.
Exact IOR, viscosity, scale, lighting power or quantitative optical accuracy.
Motion or temporal continuity: only one still was inspected.

usable_cues: Thin continuous stream retains visible edge/highlight contrast over a varied background.
Stream meets a small raised connected impact region and a spreading transparent footprint.
not_a_match_target_for: Vessel meniscus or glass/resin interface: this image pours onto flat artwork.
Exact camera composition, hardware nozzle, material parameters, or flow timing.
